title: ever ELORA|V Neck Ruched Asymmetrical Hems Midi Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
A super-stylish midi asymmetrical hems bridesmaid dress is hard to resist especially when it has a ruched bodice and belt harmonized beautifully with each other. This double V-neck midi asymmetrical hems bridesmaid dress will shift your look beyond versatile. Go for this adorable short bridesmaid dress and make ever-lasting impression on the guests at any event.

Of course, you can also choose this short burgundy dress as a party dress for Christmas this year.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Knee length.

 

Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded, with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester,
Lining:100%Polyester.

Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
